+package jdk.internal.vm.vector;
+
+import jdk.internal.access.JavaLangAccess;
+import jdk.internal.access.SharedSecrets;
+import jdk.internal.vm.annotation.ForceInline;
+
+/** Loads String code units into vectors. */
+public final class StringVectorSupport {
+
+    private static final JavaLangAccess JAVA_LANG_ACCESS = SharedSecrets.getJavaLangAccess();
+
+    @ForceInline
+    public static int stringCodeUnitSize(String string) {
+        return JAVA_LANG_ACCESS.stringCodeUnitSize(string);
+    }
+
+    @ForceInline
+    public static <VM extends VectorSupport.VectorPayload, E, S extends VectorSupport.VectorSpecies<E>>
+    VM loadStringCodeUnits(String s, int unitSize, Class<? extends VM> vmClass, int byteLanes, int index,
+                           S species, VectorSupport.LoadOperation<String, VM, S> fallback) {
+        return JAVA_LANG_ACCESS.loadStringCodeUnits(s, unitSize, vmClass, byteLanes, index, species, fallback);
+    }
+
+    private StringVectorSupport() {}
+}
